PullRequest.Title: chat: show optional sandbox CA guidance inline and align toggle hovers
PullRequest.Body:
Move the optional missing-CA notice out of the composer and into the first chat response. Keep the local Install action behind the existing confirmation, with Command Palette guidance for later. Certificate errors and required sandbox warnings keep their existing placement.

Use the standard permission-row hover for the standalone terminal sandbox toggle, including when policy changes while the picker is open.

Validation: client build and focused Electron tests for row hovers, transcript layout, accessible certificate actions, and independent prerequisite warnings passed locally.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render and update the first response in an agent-host chat while optional sandbox CA guidance is active
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Response-row rendering checks that this is the first agent-host response, resolves the owning widget, constructs one transcript ChatInputNotificationWidget, scans the in-memory notification map, and synchronously renders the notice DOM; the existing ResizeObserver then updates the row height. This is on the first-response render path, but subsequent streaming renders reuse templateData.transcriptNotice.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One transcript widget per visible first response, independent of transcript length; notification selection is linear in the process-wide active-notification count, and widget lookup is linear in the small mounted-widget collection.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous UI work on the renderer; no asynchronous fan-out. Row virtualization disposes the widget and its service listener through elementDisposables, and at most one is mounted for this transcript row.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The row caches the widget in templateData.transcriptNotice across rerenders. Scrolling the first row out and back recreates it as expected; notification bodies are recomputed on service changes rather than cached, matching the existing composer widget behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence in the synchronous construction, map scan, DOM rendering, ResizeObserver relayout, and disposal path from the changed renderer and widget implementation.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact notification and mounted-widget counts vary, but the diff bounds the added work to one visible first-response widget rather than one per response. No realistically scaling regression is established.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: the added UI work is constant per visible transcript, reused during streaming rerenders, and lifecycle-bounded.

Scenarios.Scenario: Install the optional sandbox certificate authority from the transcript notice
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The user activates the transcript button, the existing registered command opens the existing confirmation, validates the target, then awaits the host connection's installSandboxCertificate operation before refreshing notification state.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Invoke the agent-host connection's installSandboxCertificate operation, which may update the OS trust store.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One call after one confirmed Install activation; no collection fan-out.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same composer action used the same command, confirmation, busy guard, target validation, and one connection operation; the diff only relocates the action and changes its visual priority.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The operation is awaited before the progress notice returns to optional guidance state.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: A single operation for the selected chat certificate scope per user activation.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The existing _certificateBusy guard prevents overlapping certificate operations; execution is serialized for the notification instance.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Certificate capability and state come from existing connection/session observables. The placement change does not add cache lookups, misses, retries, or invalidation behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from the unchanged command registration and connection call path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Host-side installation duration is environment-dependent, but its count and placement on the action path are unchanged.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: no expensive boundary was added, duplicated, or moved onto an automatic path.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open the permissions picker and receive sandbox policy/config changes while it remains open
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Initial action items now include a string-backed hover for the standalone toggle. On an observed policy/config presentation change, the existing autorun rebuilds the action-item array and updates the list, now carrying the refreshed hover title.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: The picker item count, typically a small permission-mode list; one update per distinct sandbox presentation change because equalsAgentHostSandboxTogglePresentation suppresses unchanged states.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous observable reaction and list update; the picker disposable store removes the autorun when hidden. Filter requests retain their pre-existing delayer and are not changed by this diff.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The previous toggle presentation is retained for equality suppression and selection preservation. Hover content is a small string with no independent cache or lifecycle.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from the changed toActionItems and existing guarded autorun/updateItems path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Picker list size and policy-change frequency vary, but the diff adds only a small hover object to an already-occurring bounded list update.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: update frequency and list cardinality are unchanged, with negligible added allocation.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all eight changed files and their relevant renderer, widget, notification-service, picker, and certificate-operation call paths. The PR adds one lifecycle-bounded transcript widget and hover metadata, while the certificate host boundary remains one guarded user-triggered call. No actionable diff-introduced performance regression or qualifying regression fix was found.
